name: @lacspace/booking
description: Meeting slot finder and calendar invites: free slots from busy intervals with working hours, IANA time zones via Intl (DST-correct, half/quarter-hour offsets like Asia/Kathmandu +05:45), buffers around busy times, minimum notice, holidays, custom work weeks (e.g. Nepal Sun-Fri); human-readable slot proposals in English or Nepali; and RFC 5545/5546 iTIP REQUEST invites (VEVENT with CRLF, 75-octet UTF-8-safe folding, escaping, DTSTAMP, UID). Zero dependencies, isomorphic.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
